concepts.name: 森林木作
concepts.direction: THEME B — 森林木作. Heading above the pair reads exactly "B · 森林木作". Original premium Scandinavian-inspired wooden toy workshop, warm maple and walnut grain, smooth sanded chamfers, painted wooden animal reliefs, subtly carved facial features. Palette: muted sage, oat, honey wood, deep forest green and restrained burnt orange. Background is an airy pale sage woodland nook with minimal rounded foliage silhouettes, calm and mostly plain on gameplay. Home centerpiece: carved rabbit, ox, monkey and panda collectible toys on an elegant wooden shelf. Rounded-square tiles have ivory painted maple faces and thick real-looking honey wood sidewalls; readable animal heads are raised painted wooden inlays, not illustration stickers. Tray is a single beautifully inset maple rack with seven recessed pockets. Buttons are wood and sage painted tabs, small engraved motifs, premium carved craft. Soft warm sunlight, restrained woodgrain visible at macro scale, buttery shadows, high legibility. No rustic clutter, no generic fantasy forest. Material distinction is CARVED WOOD.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: original visual-direction concept board for the Chinese mobile tile matching game 快乐萌宠消.
Primary request: redesign the entire visual identity with tactile, premium, charming cartoon materials. Produce a polished square 2048 x 2048 concept sheet containing TWO LARGE, complete front-facing portrait mobile game screens side by side, each roughly 9:19 aspect, minimal outer margin, a narrow gutter and a small heading above. No physical phone bezels, perspective mockup or surrounding props. UI and animal artwork must be finished, crisp, readable and visually coherent.
Input image 1 is a REFERENCE ONLY: borrow the clarity of chunky layered rounded-square tiles, visible side depth, soft contact shadows, raised collectible symbols and spacious playable layout. Do not recreate its composition, purple-blue palette, symbols, typography, ads or branding. Invent a distinct identity.
Content invariants: keep original animal roster: Chinese zodiac rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, sheep, monkey, rooster, dog, pig plus cat, panda and lion. Tile icons are cute readable sculptural animal heads, never fruit, sweets or emoji. Show a representative selection with obvious species-specific silhouettes.
LEFT screen is the HOME: a small top menu control and single coin counter reading "萌宠金币 1280"; readable prominent game logo "快乐萌宠消"; four compact utility shortcuts labeled "7日签到", "萌宠图鉴", "背包道具", "声音设置"; a charming centerpiece featuring three to four original animals in this direction's material; four clearly separate large entry buttons labeled EXACTLY "经典三消", "极限四消", "趣味规则消", "闯关模式", with small animal or board symbols. No bottom tab bar.
RIGHT screen is GAMEPLAY: small settings and pause controls at the top, clear label "经典三消" and "第 2 关"; central interactive board of approximately 30 chunky rounded square animal tiles in an orderly 5-column layout with a few deliberately overlapping raised tiles showing the blocking mechanic; topmost tiles bright, covered ones mildly darkened, not opaque silhouettes. Draw ALL tile faces with the same readable front-facing camera; depth visible along lower/right edges and soft shadows. A subtle short line reads "收集 3 个相同萌宠"; near bottom a single tray with exactly SEVEN slots, the first two occupied by identical cat tiles; beneath it exactly four tactile tool buttons labeled "撤回", "铲出", "提示", "重排". Ensure board, tray and tools have generous touch spacing and hierarchy, no overlapping text.
Typography: polished friendly rounded simplified Chinese, short labels large and legible, clean typography and calm hierarchy. Keep Chinese labels verbatim. Do not add labels not specified.
Avoid: advertisements, promotional banners, copied competitor UI, WeChat system capsule, copyright logos, bottom navigation, additional reward systems, glitter clutter, cheap stock emoji, heavy black outlines, flat vector placeholder graphics, photorealistic animals. Premium stylized 3D rendered game UI, cohesive materials across characters, tiles, buttons and environment.
